categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P area label, modifies node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp, and addresses transaction request tracking and orphan handling.
categories.rationale: Fixes an orphan relay liveness bug where non-witness children remain stuck in the orphanage if a legacy parent is rejected as TX_RECONSIDERABLE from another peer. Because wtxid equals txid for non-witness transactions, forgetting the wtxid wipes queued orphan resolution requests, but since this specifically targets legacy non-segwit transactions, resolving it is reasonably deferrable.
